prompt:
Scene: flat navy #010616 canvas, 3:2 landscape presentation board, 3x2 grid of rounded-square icon tiles with strong gutters, plus one horizontal size strip row below the grid.
Subject: six refinements of ONE icon concept \u2014 the attached crop: a listening dial \u2014 a circular aperture ring built from stepped bars, like sound arranged around a centre. Refine this exact concept only; do not invent new concepts.
Details: flat geometric vector, even stroke weight, rounded terminals, bold silhouette legible at 16 pixels, one hero form per tile, generous negative space. The six cells vary exactly one property each: 1 more bars in the ring \u00b7 2 fewer, thicker bars \u00b7 3 a small gap opening at the top of the ring \u00b7 4 a small gap opening at the right of the ring \u00b7 5 bars stepping in two alternating sizes \u00b7 6 the ring with a single solid green dot at its centre. Everything else is identical across cells.
Use case: brand identity refinement sheet; the size strip below renders variant 2 at 16, 32 and 64 pixels side by side.
Constraints: exactly three colours \u2014 ink #F8F8F9, accent #21F299, navy #010616 \u2014 no other colours; no gradients, no glow, no 3D, no shadows; no letters, no words, no watermark; tiny monospace numerals 1-6 may label the cells and 16/32/64 the strip.
prompting_method: five-slot spine + change/preserve split (GPT image prompting playbook, 24/09)
